record.question: To reduce the financial burden or financial loss, which inventory control method will help a community pharmacy by keeping only fast-moving and essential medicines in stock at all times?
record.explanation: Answer A: V.E.D. analysis (Vital, essential, desirable). VED analysis classifies inventory into vital, essential, and desirable medicines, helping ensure essential items remain available while limiting unnecessary stock. Reference: https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240015731. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
